discovery.name: Discovery Coverage
discovery.description: Ratio of discovered components against the total theoretical Xbox system surface. No closed denominator exists.

analysis.name: Analysis Coverage
analysis.description: Discovered components whose ABI interfaces, imports, or instructions have been parsed and cataloged.

implementation.name: Implementation Coverage
implementation.description: Components with functional translation or proxy implementations. Stubs are strictly excluded.

testing.name: Testing Coverage
testing.description: Implemented components with passing automated unit tests.

validation.name: Validation Coverage
validation.description: Implemented components behaviorally validated against hardware golden runs.

game_requirement.name: Game Requirement Coverage
game_requirement.description: Dependencies required by the primary game executable (game_scarlett_master.exe analyzed in workspace).

anti_inflation_rules: Permanent exclusion of stubs from implementation metrics.
Prohibition of fabricated or speculative denominators.
Strict designation of global Xbox coverage as Unknown.
Decoupling of discovery progress from execution readiness.
